::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests math in the viewer's captions and descriptions** with each of
Quarto's math methods: `math-<method>.qmd` sets `html-math-method` (`mathjax`,
`katex`, `mathml`, `webtex`, `plain`; the subtitle says which). It is not part
of the website. Math in the viewer should look the same as math on the page:
typeset if the page's is, raw TeX nowhere. `webtex` loads its images from an
online service, so it needs internet access.
:::

The page has math of its own: $a^2 + b^2 = c^2$, and

$$
  \sum_{k=1}^n k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}.
$$
